findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_url, catalog_search, build_app · Private data: scan_url, scan_repo, build_app · Public sink: publish_status, build_app, build_site, publish · Destructive: scan_repo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_url, catalog_search, build_app · Private data: scan_url, scan_repo, build_app · Public sink: publish_status, build_app, build_site, publish · Destructive: scan_repo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_balance" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Shows the credit balance of this account in USD, what this key spent today, its daily spend cap, and the price of each tool. Paid tools spend this balance; when it runs out, ask a person to add credit with buy_credits_link, or pay with add_credit (a business purchase)." → after: "Use this when the person asks about their Pugi plan, credit or what they spent today. Free and read-only."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
